CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  February 7, 2022

 The audio recording of the meeting is available here: PC Meeting February 22, 2022 (Video).m4a

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:01 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  None

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner; Scott
  Quyle, Associate Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea.

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

    There were no Consent Agenda Items.

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

    There were no Discussion Items.

F.  MOTION TO REORDER THE AGENDA (7:02 P.M.)

  MOTION:
    Moved to re-order the Agenda Items to 3, 1, 2.
    Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Mojarro.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  ZONE TEXT AMENDMENT AMD-21-03 (7:04 P.M.)
   Citywide
   Applicant: Citywide
   Request: This is a proposed Zone Text Amendment, AMD-21-03, for
  an Amendment to Chapter 23.08 of the Alhambra Municipal Code

  1
  02/7/2022
   pertaining to Certificates of Occupancy. (This item is exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act)
    Recommended  Action:  Adopt  Resolution  No.  22-04,
  recommending that the City Council adopt a Resolution approving
  Zone Text Amendment, AMD-21-03, for an Amendment to Chapter
  23.08 of the Alhambra Municipal Code pertaining to Certificates of
  Occupancy.
    Pal Lam, Principal Planner, provided the Staff presentation.
    The public hearing was opened then closed.

MOTION:
    Moved to recommend approval of Agenda Item 3 to the City Council.
    Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

AGENDA
ITEM 1:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-12 (8:10 P.M.)
   1420 south 3rd Street
   Applicant: Kamen Lai
   Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-21-12 to develop a 3-story, 4-unit, apartment complex on a site
  of approximately 10,538 square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple
  Family Residential) zone. (This item is exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act)
   Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-05, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-21-12, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
   Scott Quyle, Associate Planner, provided the Staff presentation.
   Kamen Lai, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
   The public hearing was opened then closed.
   Public Comments:
  1.) Public Speaker 1

MOTION:
    Moved to approve Agenda Item 1 with conditions.
    Moved by Commissioner Ho, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

  2
  02/7/2022
   AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-20-41 AND LOT MERGER
  LOTM-21-04 (8:52 P.M.)
   918-924 East Main Street and 5 South Valencia Street
   Applicant: JCC Venture, LLC
   Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  and Lot Merger to construct a new 11,691 square foot commercial
  building that would have two (2) retail units and one (1) café unit on
  the first floor, and co-working offices located on the 2nd floor on a
  site of approximately 14,404 square feet located in the EMC (East
  Main Commercial) and P (Parking) zones. (This item is exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act)
   Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 22-07, approving
  Planned Development Permit PD-20-41 and Lot Merger LOTM-21-
  04, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
   Scott Quyle, Associate Planner, provided the Staff presentation.
   Carl Wong and Skyler Kogachi, the Applicants, were available to
  answer questions.
   The public hearing was opened then closed.
   Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Tai Costa
  3.) Ari

  MOTION:
    Moved to approve Agenda Item 1 with conditions.
    Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
    The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 10-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Ho, Juarez, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang,
  Garcia, Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: None

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

    Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso reported that the meeting regarding the Historic
  Preservation Program went well. Staff is collecting and soliciting comments on the
  Historic Context Statement until February 28th and will then finalize the document and
  bring the findings back to the Planning Commission which will conclude the first phase,
  after which we will move into the second phase. (9:26 P.M.)

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

    There were no Oral Communications.

J.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  3
  02/7/2022
     Commissioner Mojarro requested a presentation on how SB35 may affect the
  Housing Element. (9:27 P.M.)
    Vice President Garcia commented that regarding developments and the upward
  push into density, there may be more pushes for larger buildings next to single-family
  housing – shadow studies could be a reasonable ask on proposals. (9:28 P.M.)
    President Gardea agreed that shadow threshold may be appropriate in the upcoming
  zoning code. (9:31 P.M.)
    Commissioner Sahu suggested consideration of building a 3D or stick figure model
  to help neighbors visualize projects under consideration in relation to surrounding
  properties. (9:32 P.M)

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

    There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 9:33 P.M. to Monday,
  February 22, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
